title: Blood Moon

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Fighting Blood Moon Enemies/Getting Exclusive Blood Moon Items

body:
"A blood moon is rising... Find enemies around the map and fight!"

The Blood Moon is an event taking place during Halloween. It can appear any night. During the Blood Moon, unusual structures appear in 3 places: in the center of The Farlands (near The Lighthouse), The Taiga (behind Alan's AutoLogistics), and in The Savannah. The following monsters appear in these structures: Zombies, Skeletons, Pumpkin Zombies, Sword Skeletons, Vampires, Werewolves, Gremlins, and Headless Horsemen (not to be confused with the salesman). The duration of this event lasts 5 in-game hours, or 5 minutes in real life.

Monsters

Name Picture Drop
Zombie 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, 30-50% Zombie Head
Skeleton 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, 20-40% Skull
Vampires 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, Meat Vinyl Player, stake
Werewolf 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, 1-3 Moon Shard
Gremlins 5-6 Greeb
Pumpkinhead 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, 2-5 Pumpkin
Headless Horseman 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, 2-4 Pumpkin, 5% Bodyless Horse

Trivia

  • If a Skeleton is holding a Linked Sword, then there is a 90% chance it will fall out after death.
  • If a Zombie is wearing a Pumpkin, it will fall out after death.
